source.k4z_training_source: original K4Z FIT family empty/fourrooms worlds 17400..17423 (no K4Z CHECK/DEV consumed for this task)

unfamiliar_environment.public_source: same exact K4R public() observation extraction; only agent x,y,dir,goal x,y,front_blocked enters R3 and conventional online planner; never maps,walls,seed,or expert plans
unfamiliar_environment.novelty: New original MiniGrid CrossingEnv maze family and multiple wall-crossing topologies, distinct from K4Z Empty/FourRooms. Seed changes alone are not claimed as different task families.

ablations.no_episodic_edges: Use original full R3 source but after each legitimate public transition clear only blocked/open and visit episode histories; preserve trained R3 motor, R2 core and source choices; do not modify original R3 source file.
ablations.no_R2_local: Use a cloned R3 model with same FIT-learned motor and per-episode map, but replace only R2 local cell state with fresh untrained original source R2; valid isolation of retained local-plasticity contribution.
ablations.R2_static: FIT-trained unmodified Ygg R2 policy, no episodic causal online memory.
ablations.conventional_online: Original K4Z OnlinePlanner with original FIT motor learned from public transitions, same public current sensor and own observed outcomes; no hidden wall map; similar planner is an essential novelty control.
ablations.model_bfs: Original public full wall layout + fitted empirical dynamics from K4Z FIT; explicitly privileged public full-map conventional upper control.
ablations.bfs_upper: Original published public-grid full-map shortest-path expert upper bound, never native policy.

protocol.fit: Reconstruct source-original K4Z FIT action-consequence stream exactly once per fresh process; 6000 events/family, 12000 total. Train native Ygg R2 and R3 unchanged and FIT conventional motion from same source. Native checkpoints authenticated via actual native source and cold independent Python process. No reoptimization of R3 params or K4Z DEV hyperparameters.
protocol.heldout: Each method gets independent original env reset on CHECK and DEV worlds. R3 graph adaptation only from its OWN real public action consequences; R2 long-term weights immutable during heldout. For conventional online planner same per-step online updates, no hidden topology. Complete action/pose/blocked/reward traces saved.
protocol.go_no_go: To claim bounded ZERO-SHOT transfer across unfamiliar crossing topologies R3 must succeed >=4/8 in EACH crossing_1 and crossing_3; outperform its no-episodic-edges ablation by >=3 total genuine goal completions; and be no more than 2 goal completions below the equally informed conventional online optimizer over both topologies. Original source-privileged fitted dynamics+BFS must reach >=6/8 both, else source benchmark unqualified. Require exact two independent original OS process outcome identity.
protocol.native_novelty: Separate stricter criterion: R3 must beat equally informed conventional online optimistic planner by >=3/16 actual goals and not increase total measured inference+adapt CPU/memory; otherwise explicitly NO PROVEN NOVELTY or competitive Pareto improvement, even if R3 transfers.
protocol.resources: Per-method full heldout real successes, steps, blocked-forward outcomes, complete causal traces, model checkpoint bytes/hash, wall/CPU (including native Python and conventional methods), per-run peak RSS. No energy/FLOPs claim unless actually measured.
